name: Vinegar
description: Sour preserving liquid; sirka of Unani texts.

unani.note: Classical Unani calls sirka cold — disagrees with Ayurveda/TCM.

histamine.note: Clear spirit vinegar ~1; wine/balsamic vinegars are a 3.

effects.note: Acetic acid taken with a meal measurably blunts the blood glucose spike that follows — a meta-analysis of eleven trials found a real, if inconsistent, reduction in post-meal glucose and insulin response, with notable heterogeneity between studies. A tablespoon stirred into a dressing or splashed over food is close to what the trials used. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
